extracted.name: Nutty Apple Crisp
extracted.description: Lovely tart apples are sliced up and arranged in a baking dish with lemon juice, then topped with a delicious crumble made of oats, brown sugar, a bit of flour, butter, and chopped walnuts. Bake the crisp is until the apples are tender and the top lightly browned.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Toss apples with lemon juice and water in a shallow 2 quart baking dish.

In a large bowl, combine flour, oats, sugar, nutmeg, and salt. Mix to blend thoroughly. Cut in the butter or margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Mix in walnuts. Crumble over apples to cover completely.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until top is lightly browned. Serve warm or at room temperature.
